purpose: Bulk exact-field semantic evidence for the fifth team-match promotion batch. This evidence deliberately resolves legacy provider field names by family rather than treating each field as a separate research project.

legacy_opta_f9_field_reference.authority: Legacy Opta F9 field-reference mirror (third-party hosted)
legacy_opta_f9_field_reference.use: Exact legacy snake_case field keys and field-level descriptions corresponding to the packaged PulseLive/Opta-style team-match names used by FRL.

statsperform_opta_event_definitions.use: Current official conceptual corroboration for event families such as passing, defending, goalkeeping and chance creation.

semantic_resolutions.contest_family: The exact field reference distinguishes totalContest as dribble/contest attempts and wonContest as successful dribbles, while challengeLost is a missed challenge where the defender is beaten. Existing wonContest<=totalContest empirical evidence therefore becomes supporting evidence rather than the source of the definition.
semantic_resolutions.entry_family: finalThirdEntries and penAreaEntries are independently defined boundary-entry actions. V2's 35 penAreaEntries>finalThirdEntries observations only falsified a proposed nesting shortcut; they do not conflict with the now-direct field definitions.
semantic_resolutions.directional_pass_family: leftsidePass/rightsidePass and passesLeft/passesRight are separate documented concepts. The former are directional passes to the team/player side in the attacking half; the latter are passes to the corresponding wing. They must remain distinct FRL variables.
semantic_resolutions.accurate_total_pairs: The exact reference supplies both parent and successful/accurate child definitions for back-zone passes, forward-zone passes, corners into the box, keeper sweeper actions, pull-backs, through balls and throw-ins. Existing zero-violation child<=parent audits are supporting consistency evidence.
semantic_resolutions.missingness: Direct semantic resolution does not alter missingness. Any source blank remains missing unless a separate audited structural-zero rule exists.

explicitly_not_promoted_by_v5.redCard: Exact red_card and total_red_card definitions both exist. Because FRL already exposes totalRedCard, redCard remains held pending direct reconciliation of the two team-match aggregates and card-event representation.
explicitly_not_promoted_by_v5.successfulFiftyFifty: No exact field definition was established in the V5 reference pass.
explicitly_not_promoted_by_v5.successfulPutThrough: The legacy reference says this concept was Bundesliga-specific; it is not promoted merely because historical numeric rows exist.
explicitly_not_promoted_by_v5.attemptsIbox: No exact attempts_ibox key was established in the legacy reference used for this batch.
explicitly_not_promoted_by_v5.attemptsObox: No exact attempts_obox key was established in the legacy reference used for this batch.

governance_note: Exact legacy field-reference support plus existing packaged-source evidence is sufficient for source-native research exposure where no contradictory FRL evidence exists. It does not imply complete coverage, structural-zero semantics, GUI suitability, approved derived rates or current-season availability.
